authorities.offered_packets: traffic generator TX counter bound by approved profile
authorities.mirror_ingress_packets: mirror or tap ingress counter when present
authorities.nic_rx_packets: kernel interface RX packet counter snapshot
authorities.captured_packets: Probe metrics capture_snapshot.capture_packets committed once in main::run_capture
authorities.capture_allocation_drops: AF_PACKET or capture-buffer allocation/write failures before PacketBatch ownership
authorities.capture_kernel_drops: AF_XDP socket rx_dropped plus rx_ring_full, sampled as monotonic deltas
authorities.capture_errors: Capturer.poll errors; parser, PCAP writer, queue, Kafka, object and index failures are excluded

invariants: all counters are monotonic snapshots from one run identity and bounded observation window
captured_packets and captured_bytes have exactly one commit location in main::run_capture
capture_pps is derived from consecutive successful heartbeat snapshots and actual elapsed milliseconds
parser downstream queue sender Kafka object and index failures never increment capture drop counters
a run is invalid when any authoritative measurement point or signed profile receipt is missing
